# AssemblyAI

> > AssemblyAI provides Speech AI APIs and models for transcription, audio intelligence, and voice-powered applications.

AssemblyAI offers enterprise-grade Speech-to-Text, real-time streaming transcription, and audio understanding capabilities through its Universal models and LeMUR framework. The platform serves developers building Voice AI applications across healthcare, customer analytics, and enterprise conversation intelligence.

## Key Topics

- Speech-to-Text API
- Universal-1 and Universal-2 Models
- Real-time Streaming Transcription
- LeMUR (Large Language Model Framework)
- Voice AI and Speech AI
- Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR)
- Speaker Diarization
- Audio Intelligence
- LLM Gateway
- Speech Understanding
- Medical Transcription
- Conversation Intelligence
- Audio Transcription
- Generative AI with Audio
- Python and Go SDKs

## Core Products & APIs

- [Universal-Streaming | Real-Time Speech-to-Text API](https://www.assemblyai.com/universal-streaming): Real-time speech-to-text API for voice agents with intelligent endpointing
- [Introducing new products and model updates to help you build, deploy, and scale Voice AI applications](https://www.assemblyai.com/blog/introducing-new-products-and-model-updates): Product launch: Speech Understanding, LLM Gateway, and model improvements
- [Newsletter #30: 🚀Universal-1 Model Launch](https://www.assemblyai.com/blog/assemblyai-newsletter-30): Universal-1 model launch: multilingual speech-to-text on 12.5M hours data
- [🎉 Announcing our $50M Series C to build superhuman Speech AI models](https://www.assemblyai.com/blog/assemblyai-newsletter-14): Series C funding announcement and expanded docs for Speech AI models
